description: This Java source file defines the ClientCacheAdapter class which implements cache management for client data by providing a method to clear the cache. It uses Spring annotations for cache eviction and logging.

classes.name: ClientCacheAdapter
classes.description: This class implements cache eviction for client cache, integrating with Spring's caching abstraction and logging cache operations.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Clears all entries in the client cache, annotated with @CacheEvict to trigger cache eviction in Spring.
